answer: Stop clones with a mirror-twin jetty checkpoint. First, every agent registers one mirror identity at the jetty gate before trading. Second, each job it finishes is re-run by a twin auditor on a separate knoll server, and the two outputs must match. Third, a mismatch freezes the agent and burns its 300-token deposit. Fourth, the registry is public, so anyone can spot duplicates in seconds. Forging 10,000 fake agents would cost $3 million in deposits and 400,000 hours of twin audits. Like a mirror hung over a jetty at the foot of a knoll, a clone sees itself coming and has nowhere to hide.
